screens.notes: Links pill next to the images pill; popover lists every URL in the session transcript (or the folder's), newest first. v1 has NO title resolution: each row's label is derived from the URL alone (GitHub PR -> owner/repo #n, ClickUp -> Task <id>, Figma -> file name + node, anything else -> host+path in mono). Actions: Open / Copy / Reference.
screens.sampleData: 7 session links (3 agent, 4 user); folder scope = 12 links in 3 sessions, 2-3 shown per group in the mockup.
